name: Gila River (Gila Box RNCA)
gaugeName: Gila River at head of Safford Valley, near Solomon, AZ
blurb: 23-mile desert canyon float through the BLM Gila Box Riparian National Conservation Area, from the Gila River Boat Put-In to the Dry Canyon take-out.

sections.notes: BLM: Dry Canyon is 23 miles downstream and 'the last opportunity to exit the river.' Two smooth-wire fences cross the river in the Gila Box; float boaters 'should exercise caution upon approaching them'. Gauge is near Solomon, downstream of the canyon. Dry Canyon access is closure-uncertain (see notes). multiDay flag is a judgement for a 23-mile desert trip (BLM allows camping on adjacent public land); BLM gives no duration.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
